youtube.title: Where was the first X-ray ever taken? Her first words were chilling 🦴
youtube.description:
The great laboratories, the famous inventor, or the third one? A physics professor caught a new kind of ray on a photographic plate, then placed his wife's hand on it for a quarter of an hour. Her bones appeared, and her wedding ring, and she said five words nobody forgets. Within weeks doctors everywhere were using it. He refused to patent it.
Which did you pick?
